content_blocks.text: Just talk. smrt-E handles the rest

Speak, don't type. Field workers complete reports, logs, and inspections by voice. No forms, no training. Any language, delivered in English. A foreman reports in Spanish. The PM receives it in English. Both are stored. Works anywhere. offline functionality. Custom forms for any trade or workflow. Connects to existing construction management systems.A foreman speaks into his phone in Spanish at 6am. By the time the PM opens her laptop, the daily log is filed in English, tagged to the project, and flagged for safety review Contextual AI on the move BETA
